_comment: Campaign level order (game designer 2026-10-22: the lake is the first tutorial level; 2026-11-02, reconfirmed 2026-11-08: the generated Depot replaces Frozen Factory as the second level; as of 2026-11-23 mission 0.1 uses Depot X6).
